title: OpenAI's Advanced Voice Mode Now Available on ChatGPT Desktop
excerpt: OpenAI has expanded its advanced voice mode to the ChatGPT desktop app, enabling voice commands for tasks and Codex integration. This move makes AI interactions more natural across devices and offers developers a hands-free way to generate and edit code.
description: OpenAI's advanced voice mode is now on ChatGPT desktop, enabling natural voice commands and Codex integration for hands-free coding and task management.
